# QS-CFW-1466-55 - Quality specification - bearing ring CFW-1466-55 (52100)

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-1466-55

Scope
This specification defines the quality acceptance criteria, inspection method, and nonconformance handling for bearing ring CFW-1466-55 produced at Plant P2. It applies to finished forged rings supplied for machining and assembly. All requirements in this document are mandatory for lot release.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 52100 |
| Hardness | The hardness range for bearing ring CFW-1466-55 (CFW-1466-55) is 36-41 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for bearing ring CFW-1466-55 (CFW-1466-55) is ±0.05 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for bearing ring CFW-1466-55 (CFW-1466-55) is 32.2 kg. |

Inspection method
- Visual: Inspect each ring for surface defects that could affect machining or serviceability. Remove scale and lubricant prior to inspection.  
- Dimensional: Verify bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge or plug gauge appropriate for the part. Record any measurement that falls outside the bore diameter tolerance.  
- Hardness: Perform hardness checks according to the organization’s calibrated hardness tester procedure. Hardness readings shall be taken at representative locations on the ring and compared to the hardness range.  
- Weight: Confirm forging weight against the maximum forging weight requirement at receiving inspection.

Nonconformance handling
- Any item failing to meet the requirements in the table is nonconforming and shall be segregated and tagged.  
- Nonconforming items require disposition by quality. Accepted dispositions include rework to meet specification or scrap, subject to approval.  
- Records of nonconformance, disposition, and corrective action shall be maintained per company policy.
